sentences.say: A prescription says amoxicillin clavulanate, 400 milligrams per 5 millilitres, 5 millilitres twice a day.
sentences.cap: Prescribed: amoxicillin/clavulanate 400 mg per 5 mL, 5 mL twice daily.

sentences.say: The bottle says 250: same drug, wrong concentration, and the child's dose falls below the WHO range.
sentences.cap: Dispensed: 250 mg per 5 mL. A 9.5 kg child receives 52.6 mg/kg/day instead of 80 to 90.

sentences.say: WHO puts medication errors at 42 billion dollars a year.
sentences.cap: WHO: medication errors cost US$42 billion a year.

sentences.say: RxLint checks the medicine being handed over against the prescription, the way a compiler checks code.
sentences.cap: RxLint: static analysis for medication dispensing.

sentences.say: Two photos, or a FHIR prescription and a bottle photo.
sentences.cap: Photograph the prescription, or import a FHIR R4 order; verify the actual bottle.

sentences.say: On Nebius Token Factory, a vision model transcribes each photo, and NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Nano turns the transcript into typed facts, each citing the line it was copied from.
sentences.cap: Nemotron 3 Nano structures the transcript. Every value cites the line it was copied from.

sentences.say: PP-OCRv6 checks high-risk numbers, with a calibrated second gate.
sentences.cap: PP-OCRv6 corroboration + a validation-calibrated reliability head.

sentences.say: Then a deterministic kernel applies 59 rules from the WHO AWaRe book.
sentences.cap: 59 rules from the WHO AWaRe antibiotic book. Deterministic arithmetic, no model call.

sentences.say: Click any fact, and RxLint shows the pixels it was read from.
sentences.cap: Click a fact: RxLint points at the pixels it was read from.

sentences.say: The verdict is REVIEW.
sentences.cap: REVIEW: at least one deterministic rule failed.

sentences.say: The critical finding shows what was read: 400 per 5 prescribed, 250 per 5 dispensed.
sentences.cap: Observed: 400 mg / 57 mg per 5 mL prescribed, 250 mg / 62.5 mg per 5 mL dispensed.

sentences.say: The calculation is right there: 80 milligrams per millilitre against 50.
sentences.cap: Calculation: 400 / 5 = 80 mg/mL prescribed, 250 / 5 = 50 mg/mL dispensed.

sentences.say: The rule source is quoted verbatim: every finding links the pixels, the arithmetic, and the rule.
sentences.cap: Every finding links the pixels, the arithmetic and the rule it rests on.

sentences.say: Nemotron 3 Ultra explains the result to the caregiver, in English, French or Arabic.
sentences.cap: Nemotron 3 Ultra explains the verified result in English, French and Arabic.

sentences.say: It writes around locked values, so it can never invent a number.
sentences.cap: Values are locked tokens: the model writes the sentences, never a number.

sentences.say: And Nemotron 3 Nano audits every sentence against the verified result before it is shown.
sentences.cap: Nemotron 3 Nano audits each explanation against the verified result.

sentences.say: When the handwriting is overwritten, 2.5 or 7.5 millilitres, RxLint does not guess.
sentences.cap: Case D: the dose is overwritten. 2.5 or 7.5 mL?

sentences.say: It returns CANNOT VERIFY, and Nemotron 3 Ultra picks the single smallest question to ask.
sentences.cap: CANNOT VERIFY. Nemotron 3 Ultra picks the smallest clarification from a closed list.

sentences.say: Reviewed values are confirmed together, with explicit choices for ambiguity.
sentences.cap: Batch confirmation: review all unresolved values together; choose ambiguous readings explicitly.

sentences.say: The rules re-run without another model call, and the case passes.
sentences.cap: The kernel re-runs on the confirmed value. No new model call.

sentences.say: The rule pack is frozen and hashed, so a separate live plane asks: has a regulator published anything since?
sentences.cap: Plane B: has a regulator published anything since the rule pack was frozen?

sentences.say: For this French dispensing check, Tavily searches ANSM for pages naming the exact lot.
sentences.cap: Tavily Search on ansm.sante.fr only, exact match on the lot code, then Tavily Extract.

sentences.say: For this bottle, dispensed in February 2019, ANSM had recalled lot JA0287.
sentences.cap: LIVE REVIEW: the ANSM recall of 18 January 2019 names lot JA0287.

sentences.say: The live state sits next to the verdict; it never changes it.
sentences.cap: The live state never edits the deterministic verdict.

sentences.say: On 120 held-out cases, RxLint accepted zero incorrect high-risk readings.
sentences.cap: 0 incorrect high-risk readings accepted across 677 evaluated readings.

sentences.say: Forty-five percent of cases need confirmation, and label-strength accuracy is 93.3 percent.
sentences.cap: Confirmation requested on 54/120 cases. Label-strength accuracy: 93.3%.

sentences.say: 95 percent exact verdicts after simulated confirmation, against 85.8 when readings are trusted, with nine of ten overwritten doses held.
sentences.cap: 95.0% exact verdicts after simulated confirmation vs 85.8%; 9/10 overwritten doses held. Synthetic test fold.

sentences.say: A model may transcribe, report a competing reading, and write around locked values.
sentences.cap: A model may transcribe, report competing readings, choose a clarification, write around locked values.

sentences.say: It may not compute a dose, decide the verdict, or write a number.
sentences.cap: It may not convert a unit, compute a dose, decide PASS or REVIEW, or write a number.

sentences.say: RxLint: Nemotron on Nebius Token Factory reads and explains, a deterministic kernel decides, and Tavily watches the regulators.
sentences.cap: RxLint. Nemotron reads and explains. The kernel decides. Tavily watches the regulators.
